eid.title: Eid order-by dates
eid.sub: The last day to order for delivery before Eid, per delivery band and district. After a place's last day, checkout says the order may arrive after Eid instead of the usual hours.
eid.statusOn: The shop shows the dates. After a place's last day, checkout says "may arrive after Eid".
eid.statusOff: Off. Nothing about Eid is shown, and checkout keeps the usual promise.
eid.switchedOn: Switched on. The shop shows the dates now.
eid.switchedOff: Switched off. Nothing about Eid is shown now.
eid.issuesH: Before it can be switched on

issue.NO_DATES: Set at least one last day (a band or a district).
issue.DATE_AFTER_EID: A last day comes after the Eid day.
issue.UNKNOWN_BAND: A band is not one of the shop's bands.
issue.PREORDER_NO_ADVANCE: Pre-order is on but its advance is not set.
issue.BANNER_NEEDS_DATE: The banner words must contain {date} in both languages.
issue.PREORDER_TEXT_NEEDS_AMOUNTS: The pre-order words at checkout must contain {advance} and {due} in both languages.
issue.PREORDER_BANNER_NEEDS_ADVANCE: The pre-order banner words must contain {advance} in both languages.

eid.datesD: Empty = no date. A district's own date wins over its band's.
eid.cutoffTime: Last minute of the day that still counts
eid.cutoffHelp: 24-hour time. An order after it counts as the next day.
eid.noDistricts: No district has its own date.
eid.wordsHelp: Both languages. {band}, {date}, {eid}, {advance} and {due} fill in by themselves.
eid.lateText: At checkout after a place's last day
eid.readOnly: You can look but not change this.
eid.preOwner: Takes money: only the owner (or someone he allowed) can change it.
eid.preD: Off: after a place's last day the order is an ordinary order with the "may arrive after Eid" line. On: such an order asks the advance now (bKash, Nagad or card, the same payment page as any advance) and the rest on delivery.
eid.previewD: From the saved settings, in the shop's time zone.
eid.placeClosed: {band}: past its last day — "may arrive after Eid"

error.EID_INVALID: Not saved: fix the points listed first (switch off before changing a date that would break it).
error.INVALID_INPUT: Not saved: a value is not valid ({fields}).
error.OWNER_OK_REQUIRED: Only the owner can change pre-order.
error.forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.

holiday.title: Delivery settings
holiday.sub: Optional features start off; every number is editable.
holiday.d: The days the shop sends nothing. The shop stays open: a notice shows the dates, and during those days checkout says the order ships from the day after instead of the usual hours.
holiday.enabledHelp: Needs the first and last day.
holiday.pairHelp: Write the words in both languages.
holiday.readOnly: You can look but not change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this; it was read again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Not saved: a value is not valid ({fields}).
err.forbidden: You do not have the right to do this.

sticker.d: Prints a Bengali address again in Latin letters under it on the courier sticker, with the area and district in English, for riders and hub staff who read Latin letters faster. The Bengali address stays the one that counts.
sticker.enabledHelp: Only for addresses written in Bengali. An address already in Latin letters prints once.

promise.d: A far district can promise its own delivery time instead of its band's: checkout, the thank-you page, the order page and the late flag use it. A district with no row keeps its band's time. The charge does not change.
promise.rowsHelp: Hours from when the order is placed; the longest is when an order counts as late.
promise.empty: No district has its own time yet.

voice.d: A mic under the address box: the customer says his address in Bengali and it is written for him. The order is marked “Voice-entered” and keeps the recording; an unsure reading is marked “Voice — please call” and gets a call task. Phones with their own speech engine (Chrome on Android) read it themselves; others send the recording to “Speech to text” in Keys & connections (until its key is in, the team listens).
voice.enabled: Show the mic in the address box
voice.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. The browser asks for the microphone only after the customer taps.
voice.speechLangHelp: A language code the speech engines know, e.g. bn-BD (Bengali) or en-US.
voice.minConfidence: Call when the reading is less sure than
voice.minConfidenceHelp: Below this the order is marked “Voice — please call”. No reading at all always asks for a call.
voice.keepRecording: Keep the recording with the order
voice.keepRecordingHelp: The team can play it on the order page. Off: only the words are kept.
voice.maxPerHour: Recordings one browser may send an hour
voice.maxPerHourHelp: Stops one browser filling the storage.

tracking.d: The shop asks each courier about the parcels it holds, on its own, and the order follows its parcel (in transit, delivered, returned). A person can always press "Read now" on a parcel.
tracking.enabled: Read the couriers on their own
tracking.enabledHelp: Off: nothing is read unless a person presses "Read now", and orders do not move by themselves.
tracking.everyMinutes: Minutes between two reads of a parcel
tracking.everyMinutesHelp: 5 to 1,440. A courier that calls the shop itself (below) is read less often than this anyway.
tracking.batchHelp: 1 to 2,000. The rest are read on the next run.

booking.d: What goes to the courier when a person books a parcel on Orders › Packing & print. Booking is always a person's press, never automatic.
booking.giftLeadDays: Earliest booking of a gift: days before its day
booking.giftLeadDaysHelp: 0 to 30. 0: a gift is booked on its "deliver on or after" day, not before.
booking.giftNoteHelp: Up to 200 letters. {sender}, {date} and {note} are filled in from the order.
booking.noteLang: Language of the note to the courier
booking.itemNames: Send the pieces' names to the courier
booking.itemNamesHelp: Off: the courier is told only how many pieces are in the parcel.
booking.maxPerRun: Most parcels one "Book all" press books
booking.maxPerRunHelp: 1 to 500. The oldest ready orders go first; press again for the rest.

selection.d: While on, "Book courier" offers the courier with the lowest cost for this parcel first (from the courier rates on Money › Costs & fees), and lists every courier with its cost. The customer's delivery charge never changes.
selection.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. With no rates entered, no courier has a cost and the choice stays the team's.
selection.codFee: Count the courier's Cash on Delivery fee in the cost
selection.codFeeHelp: Only for the comparison between couriers; nothing is charged.

webhooks.d: Steadfast and Pathao can call the shop the moment a parcel moves, so the order moves at once. The address and the token are on Settings › Keys & connections, on each courier's row; the hourly read above stays the fallback.
webhooks.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. Turn it on once the courier's webhook page has the shop's address.
webhooks.maxBodyKbHelp: 1 to 1,024. A bigger call is refused without being read.

zoneSync.d: Couriers like Pathao book only with their own city, zone and area numbers. The shop reads each courier's list and pairs it with its own areas, so a booking never fails on "unknown area". "Read the list now" is on Delivery › Couriers.
zoneSync.enabled: Read the lists on their own
zoneSync.enabledHelp: Off: a list is read only when a person presses "Read the list now".
zoneSync.everyDays: Days between two readings of a list
zoneSync.callsPerRunHelp: 10 to 5,000. A long list is read in parts; the next part goes on next time.
zoneSync.areas: Read the areas too (the third level)
zoneSync.areasHelp: Off: only cities and zones are read.
zoneSync.autoMatch: Pair a place whose name is exactly one of the shop's areas
zoneSync.autoMatchHelp: Off: every pair is made by a person on the courier's page.
zoneSync.unmapped: A parcel to an area with no pair
zoneSync.unmappedHelp: A courier that needs its own numbers always waits for a pair.

rules.whenRequired: Waits only for a courier that needs its numbers
rules.always: Waits for at least the city with every courier that takes numbers

packing.moreNote: How the packing table works (Orders › Packing & print › Pack). Each is the owner's choice; a card saved here applies to the next order at the table.

check.d: How each piece is checked before "Mark packed".
check.modeHelp: Scan: the SKU scanned must match a line of the order. Tick: one tick per line, for a shop that packs without a scanner.
check.allowTyped: Let the packer type the SKU
check.allowTypedHelp: With Scan: when the scanner is off, the SKU can be typed instead.

photo.d: A photo of the open parcel before it is closed, kept as proof (CN-014c). Off as shipped.
photo.enabledHelp: Off: no photo is asked for.
photo.modeHelp: Required: "Mark packed" and the courier booking wait for the photos (the owner can waive it for one order, with a reason). Reminder: the screen asks, nothing waits.
photo.keepDaysHelp: 1 to 3,650. Then the photo is archived, never shown on the order again.

weight.d: The scale's reading against the pieces' own weights. Off as shipped.
weight.enabledHelp: Off: no weight is asked for or checked.
weight.gapPercent: Flag when off by more than (%)
weight.gapHelp: A reading is flagged only when it is off by more than both. "Mark packed" then asks to weigh again or confirm.
weight.requireReading: A reading is needed before "Mark packed"

queue.d: What the Pick, Pack, Ready and Handed over steps list.
queue.doneDays: Days handed-over orders stay on "Handed over"
queue.listMax: Orders one step lists at most

issues.d: What "Report defect / out of stock" at the table does. Nothing is decided by itself: a person picks the way out on the card.
issues.holdOrder: Hold the order while a card is open
issues.holdOrderHelp: Off: the order stays where it is; the card still stops "Mark packed".
issues.damagedReasonKey: Hold reason for a defective piece
issues.missingReasonKey: Hold reason for a missing piece
issues.editReasonKey: Edit reason for a swap or "send the rest"
